headline: Senegal 2027: when the budget crisis meets the financing wall
summary: Senegal's National Assembly rejected the initial 2027 finance bill on 18 November 2026. The country must simultaneously finance its deficit, refinance considerable debt and preserve access to the regional market.
why: Senegal's budget and debt financing shape its sovereign borrowing costs and access to the West African regional bond market, which matters for investors in its government debt.
original_headline: Sénégal 2027 : quand la crise budgétaire rencontre le mur du financement
